correctness.rationale: Exact nonnegative Fourier coefficients prove the circular case. The spherical-sign feature integral and a four-point annihilator prove full-support positive semidefiniteness and nonstrictness. Twice integrating the Legendre equation gives the coefficient identity; a finite generating-function expansion bounds the integral remainder by O(log n/n), and standard Darboux asymptotics give a dominant sign-oscillating n^{-5/2} term. A periodic/dense rotation argument supplies infinitely many negative degrees, which violate Schoenberg positivity on S2 and all higher spheres by restriction. Finite quadrature checks passed but are not used as infinite proof.
